title: fix(app-shell): draw a served object or list view label as served in the Console sidebar, recent list and object list header
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRs2m6UxsYUoAdT4puvameb)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Refs #30311

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 侧栏里未写标签的对象/列表视图入口、侧栏与首页的「最近访问」里的对象行和列表视图行、对象列表页标题、顶栏对象标题、对象 `/data` 页标题，改为直接显示服务端返回的名字；只有服务端没给名字（客户端自己派生的视图、还没读到的对象、待发布草稿）时才查客户端词典。
- 为什么改：客户在 `.custom` 里给已安装包的对象或列表视图改了名，服务端返回新名字，但 Console 拿服务端的名字再去查词典，基础包的旧译名又把它盖回去；实测 zh-CN 下对象页标题和最近访问仍显示「任务」「进行中」。
- 风险与回滚：未改名的条目显示不变（服务端本就用同一份词典翻译）；记录页、表单、抽屉等其余约 43 处同类调用本 PR 未改，交席位立收口卡。回滚即还原本 PR。应用名一半等 #30062 服务端，所以写 Refs 不关卡。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`（object/view 分支与 `servedObjectPluralLabel`）；② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` 的 `listTitleOf`（标题、收藏、无标签视图同一来源）；③ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` 对象分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useRecentItemLabel.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.servedLabels-11295.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listTitlePlural-11696.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.listTitlePlural-11696.test.tsx`，预期 4 个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule (the one PR #30308 applied to report, page and dashboard).** A label the `/meta` read or the app bundle served is already translated by the server, by its label order for an overridden item (#30193), so it is drawn as given. The catalog key (`useObjectLabel`'s `objectLabel` / `objectPluralLabel` / `viewLabel`) is asked only for text no server translated.
- `useNavTargetLabel.ts`
  - `object` target (an unlabelled sidebar entry): the served object's label as given; a pending draft's label still goes through the catalog.
  - `view` target (an unlabelled sidebar entry, and a recent view row): a served view's label as given, decided by `isServedView` — the identity question the object page's view tabs already ask (objectui#11295, objectui#11336). A view the client derived (a container expansion) still goes through `viewLabel`. By name, the served reads are the names-only scope's own `served` and `views`, from the same `readObjectScope` call `readObjectsByName` makes, so no new request.
  - New private helper `servedObjectPluralLabel(def, language, objectPluralLabel)`: what a served object's list is called — served `pluralLabel`, else served `label`, else the catalog under its name. Internal to app-shell (not in the package index).
- `useRecentItemLabel.ts`: the recent object row uses `servedObjectPluralLabel`.
- The object list header (Expected names the header; the seat widened the claim's surface, comment 6652505627, narrowed in 6652679548):
  - `ObjectView.tsx`: one `listTitleOf` feeds the page header's object crumb (`ObjectViewPageHeader`), the list favorite's label and an unlabelled view's tab text, so the three still agree (the header compares the tab text with the plural).
  - `AppHeader.tsx`: the object route's title, and the unlabelled-view fallback on a view route.
  - `ObjectDataPage.tsx`: the `/data` page title.
- **Not changed:** `ui/packages/i18n` (`useObjectLabel` is published; changing its order is a `Clause-②` question). The rest of the family — record pages, record forms, drawers, preview cards, and call sites outside app-shell — is listed in Acceptance notes for the seat's closing card.

## Tests

- New, one top-level describe per existing harness:
  - `useRecentItemLabel.test.tsx` (objectstack#30311 describe, 9 cases): renamed object and view in the recent list and in `useNavTargetLabel` (whole-list and names-only-scope reads), served plural first, a view embedded in the served object document; controls: a client-derived view, an object the cache does not hold, a pending draft object, en.
  - `AppHeader.servedLabels-11295.test.tsx` (4 cases), `ObjectView.listTitlePlural-11696.test.tsx` (2), `ObjectDataPage.listTitlePlural-11696.test.tsx` (2).
- **Fixtures that served English in a zh-CN session** (the world PR #30308 named as not occurring: the Console's catalog is the server's own `/api/v1/i18n/translations/:locale` answer, and the server translates a served label with it): `useRecentItemLabel.objectPlural-11733`, `ObjectView.listTitlePlural-11696`, `ObjectView.listLinksPlural-11733`, `ObjectView.labelLessViewTab-12774`, `ObjectDataPage.listTitlePlural-11696`, `AppHeader.objectCrumbPlural-11696`, `AppHeader.labelLessViewTitle-12805`, `StudioDesignSurface.standardNavEntries-11201` (8 files) now serve the zh-CN answer in zh-CN. Every existing assertion is unchanged.
- **Ablation** (the five source files restored to `ff3f83bb` with `git restore --source`, marker count 0 on disk, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git status` clean and blob hashes equal to HEAD after): `Tests 9 failed | 63 passed (72)`. The 9 are exactly the renamed cells (object page title, app header en/zh, `/data` title, recent object, recent plural, recent/nav view, names-only scope, embedded view); every control stayed green.

<details><summary>Test runs</summary>

- Pins, fix in place: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 72 passed (72)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Consumer sweep 1 (before the header half; 563 test files in app-shell and the Console that reference a module importing either hook): `Test Files 1 failed | 562 passed (563)`, `Tests 1 failed | 4324 passed (4325)`. The red was `StudioDesignSurface.standardNavEntries-11201` (English served in zh-CN), fixed as above.
- Consumer sweep 2 (after merging `origin/main` and rebuilding, head `23114841`): the 6 pin files plus 136 more test files that reference `ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage` or `AppHeader`: `Test Files 1 failed | 140 passed (141)`, `Tests 2 failed | 1395 passed (1397)`. The 2 reds were `ObjectView.listLinksPlural-11733`'s zh-CN cells (English served in zh-CN), fixed as above; that file then `Tests 7 passed (7)` at `ec3b0e69`. This sweep ran 136 of the 298 test files its own reference search found, not all of them (see Acceptance notes).
- Consumer sweep 3 (CI at `ec3b0e69` red on 7 zh-CN cells in `AppHeader.objectCrumbPlural-11696`, `AppHeader.labelLessViewTitle-12805` and `ObjectView.labelLessViewTab-12774`, reproduced locally, fixtures fixed at `1553cdd6`): every `AppHeader.*`, `ObjectView.*` and `ObjectDataPage.*` test in app-shell, `Test Files 114 passed (114)`, `Tests 929 passed (929)`; then all 298 files of sweep 2's reference search at `6583026f` (`origin/main` merged in, no `ui/` file among the 37 it brought), in three locked runs: `Test Files 97 passed (97)` / `101 passed (101)` / `100 passed (100)`, `Tests 905` / `790` / `950 passed`, each `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed TypeScript files (at `23114841`): 0 errors (104 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2` at `ec3b0e69`: `Tasks 68 successful`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Live (showcase `--fresh`, zh-CN, Console from `ui/` src through Vite)

Overrides written the way the platform takes them: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` (pair `com.example.showcase.custom`); the object through an `object_extension` (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_task?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft` with `extend`, `label: Work Item (renamed-30311)`, `pluralLabel: Work Items (renamed-30311)`, then publish — an object `overrides` save is refused `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, ADR-0146 D10); the view through a view override (`showcase_task.in_progress`, `label: In flight (renamed-30311)`, `overrides: { package: 'com.example.showcase', basedOn: '0.1.0' }`, then publish).

Served under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` after the overrides: `/meta/object/showcase_task` → `Work Item (renamed-30311)` / `Work Items (renamed-30311)`; `/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` → `In flight (renamed-30311)`; the app bundle `/meta/app/showcase_app/bundle` carries the renamed object too. The zh-CN catalog keeps `objects.showcase_task.label` = 任务 and `_views.in_progress.label` = 进行中.

| Console, zh-CN, same overrides | `origin/main` ui (`ff3f83bb` sources) | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| object list page title (crumb) | 任务 / 全部任务 | Work Items (renamed-30311) / 全部任务 |
| view page title | 任务 / In flight (renamed-30311) | Work Items (renamed-30311) / In flight (renamed-30311) |
| sidebar 「最近使用」 | 客户 · 任务 · 进行中 | 客户 · Work Items (renamed-30311) · In flight (renamed-30311) |
| Home 「最近访问」 | 客户 · 任务 · 进行中 | 客户 · Work Items (renamed-30311) · In flight (renamed-30311) |

Each leg restarted the Console's Vite (`--force`) after switching the five sources and checked that the served modules carried (or lacked) the change before the run: the first after-run read a stale transform from Vite's watcher. Screenshots (1440×900 at 2×, before/after of the object page, the view page, the expanded sidebar recent group and Home) are in the project's files at `ui-seat3/30311-shots/`; this channel cannot upload images to the PR body, so the table above is their text.

The live leg did not reach an unlabelled sidebar entry: every showcase navigation entry carries its own label, so the sidebar's object/view rows draw those (unchanged). That path is pinned by the `useNavTargetLabel` cases.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's premise "the object's own page shows the new name" did not hold.** Measured above: on `origin/main` the object page title also showed 任务. The seat folded the header into this PR and named the rest of the family for a closing card.
- **The rest of the family, not touched here** (`objectLabel(` / `objectPluralLabel(` over a served definition, at `23114841`): in app-shell, `AppContent` 4, `ActivityObjectLabel` 1, `ConsoleLayout` 1, `ObjectView` 3 more (import wizard, delete confirmations, `objectLabelOf`), `ObjectDataPage` 1 (record drawer title), `RecordDetailView` 11, `RecordFormPage` 2, `appReportIndex` 2, `RecordPreviewCard` 1, `recordDrawerStack` 2, `PackagedActionsSection` 1, `WidgetRefCellFaces` 1; outside app-shell: `fields` `RecordHoverCard` 1, `plugin-detail` 3, `plugin-form` 2, `plugin-gantt` 1, `plugin-grid` 1. Some pass text no server translated (`{ name, label: name }` fallbacks, a widget ref's own `label`), so each needs a per-site reading. The other way to close the class is to change `useObjectLabel`'s own order, a `Clause-②` card.
- **A rename of `label` alone keeps the served plural.** The server translates `label` and `pluralLabel` separately: an extension that renames only `label` still serves the base's translated `pluralLabel`, so a list title (which reads the plural first) keeps it. That is the server's answer and Studio's; the live leg renamed both.
- **Deviation: an incomplete consumer sweep.** Sweep 2 was described as covering every test file that references `ObjectView`, `ObjectDataPage` or `AppHeader`; it ran 136 of the 298 its search found. Three of the 162 it skipped carried the same English-in-zh-CN fixture and went red in CI at `ec3b0e69`. They are fixed at `1553cdd6` and the full 298 now pass (sweep 3).
- **App labels** are unchanged (the app half waits for #30062's server half), hence `Refs`.

## Verification

- Since `ec3b0e69` the branch gained three test-fixture files (`1553cdd6`) and a merge of `origin/main` (`6583026f`, no `ui/` file). `dispatch-gates --commands` at `1553cdd6` derives the same 35 commands; they were not re-run there. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` at `6583026f`: exit 0 (#30367 fixed on `main` by #30368).
- Derived gates on `ec3b0e69`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` lists 35 commands (the same list as at `23114841`), each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all 35 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` ran under `os-verify-lock` with `--maxWorkers=2` (`Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`): its first run at `23114841`, with the showcase stack up, was SIGKILLed for memory.
- `ui/scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` at `ec3b0e69`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30311-served-object-view-labels.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, both declaration lines.
